summary: Re-ran the full AI coach add-exercise test surface after EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was rotated and the two hardening fixes (try/except around chat.send_message returning a graceful added_exercise:null fallback, and newline-preserving current_session sanitiser) were applied. E2E LLM suite (test_coach_add_exercise.py) → 7/7 PASSED on first attempt (no retries needed). Pure-function validator suite (test_coach_add_exercise_validator.py) → 18/18 PASSED. Every behavioural case from the review request is now green: (1) happy path add face pulls 3x12 emits added_exercise with id starting 'added-ex-', valid category, sets=3, reps containing '12', name matching Face Pulls; response text has NO <ADD_EXERCISE> / </ADD_EXERCISE> / <PROGRAM_CHANGE> tag leaks and confirms naturally. (2) Prehab-style shoulder dislocates add → added_exercise present with a category coerced into the allowed COACH_EXERCISE_CATEGORIES set. (3) Malformed / no-name add → HTTP 200, added_exercise is null (no phantom fabrication). (4) 'How should I warm up before squats?' → HTTP 200, added_exercise null, no tag leak. (5) current_session snapshot with both an added Face Pulls exercise and a logged Back Squat 315x5 → coach response references both items (newline preservation working). (6) Regression on a plain educational message → response shape intact (response/sources/conversation_id/has_program_change/program_change/added_exercise), added_exercise null. (7) <PROGRAM_CHANGE> swap on flat bench → floor press still fires with has_program_change=true and a well-shaped program_change dict. Total wall-clock for the LLM suite was 31s — no 500s, no timeouts, no retries triggered. Backend logs remained clean during the run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~7900 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the coach chat / plan generator / calendar modules into their own routers. Not blocking, but the file is becoming a merge-conflict magnet.
@app.on_event('startup')/('shutdown') at server.py:3587 and :7874 emit DeprecationWarnings — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers at some point.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the pre-seeded user_a@theprogram.app account. No writes to persistent state — coach_chat does not mutate today_added_exercises server-side (that persistence is frontend AsyncStorage per the request note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env is valid and the try/except fallback around chat.send_message is in place, so POST /api/coach/chat should always return HTTP 200 with the full response schema (including added_exercise). If any future coach test 500s, first check backend.err log for the LLM error and confirm the fallback path is still returning JSON. The login field is `token`, not `access_token`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration 75 failure was purely the invalid placeholder EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. With the key rotated and the graceful fallback wrapper added, the coach endpoint no longer 500s on transient LLM errors, and all behavioural + validator tests pass cleanly.
